mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention and triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weak aggregate demand, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 92.0 in two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which signals an imminent economic slowdown and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal shows no statistical significance (p > 0.05) in walk-forward testing.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real personal consumption (RSAFS) following two consecutive months of decline indicates a recovery in consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases after two consecutive monthly declines
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in recovery instances, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.25% after a prolonged period of near-zero policy signals the start of a monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances following FEDFUNDS > 0.25% after prolonged low rates, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3.0% annualized in two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during strong GDP growth periods, or the signal shows no outperformance in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.
